newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices steady to lower.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices steady to lower.

text.p: Millfeed prices remained mostly steady to weaker Tuesday, weighed down by sluggish demand and ample nearby supply, several dealers said.
"We need some real live demand somewhere and we don't have it yet," a Kansas dealer said.
But another dealer said the market was stumbling along the bottom trying to find support. "It may or may not," he said. But he noted prices were expected to stabilize by mid-July.
"It's June and we are seeing a typical June market with some pretty good run times at flour mills and just a normal slowdown in demand for finished feeds," a Buffalo dealer said.

"It's exaggerated this year a little more so than some because of low milk prices," he said. "Farmers just don't have a lot money on farm to spend on feed and if they can replace it with pastures or whatever, that's what they would do."
